reasoning: A keeps every cue playing on time with a counted cache and clone-per-cue playback, and passes all checks. Its only notable gap is that PickerOpen is held for the HUD's lifetime. B scopes the picker sounds better, but restarting a single Sound cuts off rapid cues, cues that load late are dropped (a behaviour regression), and it fails StyLua in its own code.

criteria.criterion: Cues play from a pre-existing loaded Sound
criteria.note: UiSounds.hold keeps a cached Sound in UiSoundCache and play clones it; the flagged Ended:Once destroy only cleans up the per-cue clones.

criteria.criterion: Picker sounds kept only around build mode
criteria.note: PickerOpen is held by app() for the HUD's whole life, so it is never released after build mode; PickerClose is held from the picker body and its release is deferred so the close cue still plays.
holdCounts is counted per id, the destroy is deferred to survive a release followed by a new hold, and releasing twice does nothing.

criteria.criterion: Rapid cues each play, no pile-up
criteria.note: cached:Clone() per cue lets cues overlap, and each clone is destroyed on Ended.
Explains the cause, who holds what, the UiSoundCache Explorer check, a ChildAdded snippet that prints IsLoaded at play time, a phone check and the known gap.
All cues fire at the same moments, unheld sounds fall back to the old behaviour with a Studio warning, and all checks pass.

criteria.criterion: Cues play from a pre-existing loaded Sound
criteria.note: hold creates one Sound per id and preloads it with PreloadAsync; play reuses entry.Sound.

criteria.criterion: Picker sounds kept only around build mode
criteria.note: warmPickerSounds runs on hover, press and build-mode entry, and coolPickerSounds releases after a 30 s linger; entering with the B key gives little time to load.
Entry.Holds is counted and the Sound is destroyed when it reaches 0.

criteria.criterion: Rapid cues each play, no pile-up
criteria.note: A single Sound is restarted with TimePosition = 0, so a rapid cue cuts off the previous one.
Clear steps including a phone check, but the IsLoaded check requires editing code, and the note admits cues can be dropped.
Cues not loaded within 80 ms are dropped and unheld sounds are skipped, which changes existing behaviour; StyLua fails on its own warn line.

strengths: Clean counted cache with deferred release
Clone-per-cue playback so rapid cues overlap
Strong note with an IsLoaded verification snippet
weaknesses: PickerOpen stays loaded for the HUD's whole life, not only around build mode
PickerClose only starts loading when the picker opens

strengths: Picker sounds scoped to build mode with intent-based warm-up
weaknesses: Reusing one Sound cuts off rapid cues
